gaps.title: Provision-instance identity is implicit
gaps.problem: Classifier binds a concept to a Section but the resulting Provision has no stable ID separate from the Section. Re-ingestion can create a duplicate Provision row for an unchanged underlying concept.
gaps.fix: Provision ID = hash(deal_id, kind, concept_key, ordinal-within-section). Persist across re-ingestion.

gaps.title: Excerpts are anonymous
gaps.problem: Excerpts have Verbatim text and a Provenance location but no stable Excerpt ID. Re-runs can't identify the same quote span idempotently.

gaps.title: Normalizer has no manifest
gaps.problem: Normalizers are scattered under lib/vocab/*-aliases.js with no single manifest listing each Normalizer's Attribute, version, and canonical target.
gaps.fix: Add lib/vocab/manifest.js — one export listing {attribute, aliases_file, version, canonical_target_attribute}. Load-time validated. Surface in /admin/taxonomy.

gaps.title: Provenance is a bundle in spec, scattered fields in code
gaps.problem: Taxonomy names Provenance as {document, location, extractor, extracted_at, confidence}. In practice these fields live in different places — some on the Claim row, some on the Excerpt, some in the reconciliation log.
gaps.fix: Introduce provenance:{...} sub-object on every persisted Claim. Migration writes existing fields into it. Backwards-compatible via projection.

gaps.title: Prompt version and code SHA not systematically stamped
gaps.problem: Provenance spec requires prompt version + code SHA. Some paths stamp them, some don't. Retrospective re-runs rely on file history rather than stamped Provenance.
gaps.fix: Central extractor-stamp.js helper. Every LLM call routes through it. CI invariant refuses to persist a Claim without a fully populated Provenance.extractor.

gaps.title: Reconciliation log actions have no Taxonomy target
gaps.problem: Seven action types (MERGE, MOVE_FIELD, RECLASSIFY_FIELD, RECODE_FIELD, RESET_ENUM, SPLIT, SCHEMA_DEFERRED) have no canonical mapping onto Taxonomy nodes/edges. Reviewers can't filter by node.
gaps.fix: Add taxonomy_target field to each log entry: one of {Deal, DealProfile, Section, Provision, Excerpt, Claim, Attribute, Canonical, Normalizer, Registry, ReferencesDefinitionEdge}.

gaps.title: Ingest QA does not exercise Normalizer citation
gaps.problem: QA checks unverified quotes and duplicate clauses but not whether Canonical assignments cite a Normalizer rule. Free-text drift can pass unnoticed.
gaps.fix: QA check: every Canonical must cite identity (Verbatim == Canonical) or a specific Normalizer rule ID.

gaps.title: DealProfile Claims share Excerpt-requiring pipeline
gaps.problem: DealProfile Claims (parties, closing date, jurisdiction) synthesised from cover pages sometimes get spurious Excerpts attached to satisfy the schema.
gaps.fix: Explicit DealProfile branch at stage 3. Attributes flagged scope=deal route to a lighter extractor. Excerpt nullable for scope=deal Attributes.

gaps.title: No admin surface renders the runtime flow
gaps.problem: Taxonomy has /admin/taxonomy. Runtime flow has no admin page — new engineers can't see stages, files, or per-stage metrics.
gaps.fix: /admin/processing-flow — mermaid + stage cards + gap panel. Deep-links to Provision-instance detail pages.

gaps.title: Cross-Section definitions resolution is undefined
gaps.problem: Extractor sees one Section at a time. When an operative Provision references a defined term whose definition-Provision lives elsewhere, there is no formal resolution mechanism.
gaps.fix: Two-pass extraction. Pass 1 extracts all definition-Provisions and builds a deal-wide definitions map. Pass 2 extracts operative-Provisions with the definitions bundle as additional prompt context. Inline definitions do not require pass ordering — they are already visible in their containing Section.

gaps.title: Provision kind field is not persisted
gaps.problem: Taxonomy v3 introduces Provision.kind in {operative, definition} and the references_definition edge. Persisted schema does not yet carry these.
gaps.fix: Add kind field to Provision. Add references_definition edge array. Migration sets kind=operative on every existing Provision. Freeze Gate PR required.
